reference.name: Commit detail summary uses incorrect singular/plural grammar for one changed file
reference.summary: Commit detail and branch comparison diff summaries use plural “files” when exactly one file changed.
reference.expected: Diff summaries should use singular “file” when exactly one file changed.
reference.actual: A commit changing one file displays “1 changed files with 1 additions and 0 deletions”. Comparing docs/release-owners against main also displays “1 changed files with 5 additions and 0 deletions”.
reproSteps: Open an authenticated repository's commit history.
Open a commit that changes exactly one file.
Read the changed-files summary above the diff and observe that it says `1 changed files with 1 additions and 0 deletions`.
Reported comparison-page variant: open eval/harbor-handbook → Branches and choose New Pull Request beside docs/release-owners, with main as the base.
Read the comparison summary and observe “1 changed files with 5 additions and 0 deletions”.

knownHits.reason: Matches the reviewed comparison-page pluralization defect: a single changed file is described as '1 changed files'. The same repro case includes this comparison-page variant.
